A demanding handover began when an unclear instruction was first spotted by our head trainer. Companion Animal Travel Desk Incident Note

During routine booking review, the desk found a pet travel file with one instruction that could have been read in more than one way. The record concerned a passenger route linked to Aurelia Skyways, and the unclear point related to crate handling at transfer. Because safety takes priority over speed in every journey, the file was paused before any confirmation was issued. The clerk on duty checked the original notes, compared them with the approved care record, and asked the senior coordinator to review the wording. The matter was then raised with the head trainer, who confirmed that the intent was to keep the animal under direct supervision during each changeover and not to release it to baggage handling.

The desk updated the booking notes, added a clear care reminder, and sent the corrected version to the pickup team. The traveler contact was held until the wording matched the approved process, and the pet travel plan was then returned to normal processing. No distress to the animal was observed, and no missed transfer occurred. The Companion Animal Travel Desk also reminded staff that every journey must be checked from booking through pickup, since small wording errors can affect welfare and delay service.

Follow-up action was completed by placing the file under review for one more check before release, and the corrected note was saved with the rest of the travel record. Staff were reminded to flag any uncertain wording at once, and the desk will continue to verify similar entries with care. The record is closed with no further action required. Companion Animal Travel Desk
